name: Stock Streaks (Geometric Model)
description: Days since a stock index last rose, over 1,362 trading days, vs. a geometric model. IMS Ch. 16 (goodness-of-fit).
studyDescription: Over 1,362 trading days, each day was classified by how many consecutive days of increase preceded it (1, 2, …, 6, or 7+). If daily movements are independent, the counts should follow a geometric distribution. The goodness-of-fit test compares the observed streak counts to that geometric model.

variableDescriptions.streak: The number of consecutive prior days of increase (1–6, or 7 or more) before a given trading day.

sourceDetail: IMS Ch. 16 goodness-of-fit example (geometric model for stock streaks). Observed 717/369/155/69/28/14/10; geometric-model expected 743/338/154/70/32/14/12. χ² = 4.61, df = 6, p ≈ 0.60 — consistent with independence.
